title: syringa wolfii var. hirsuta
intro: Syringa wolfii var. hirsuta, commonly known as the Chinese lilac, is a plant species in the Oleaceae family. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Syringa wolfii var. hirsuta include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help reduce swelling and fight infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, antipyretic, and expectorant properties.
